title_o: Coming Out in the Classroom... An Occupational Hazard?: The Influence of Sexual Orientation on Teacher Credibility and Perceived Student Learning

replications.quote: we did not find the same result as they did: gay instructors were not rated lower in credibility and learning by the students in our sample.
Participants as a collective did not provide significantly different ratings for any dimension of credibility nor for perceptions of learning in either condition.
